result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, Customer Data export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. It does not alter unrelated commercial terms. However, it is poorly placed after the Section 18 INSURANCE heading and is unnumbered; it should appear as a new Section 10.3 before Section 18. The backup and legal-retention exceptions are customary, though the clause would be stronger if retained copies remained protected and were deleted when the exception ceased to apply.
